5.0.SP2.description: Last price expressed in percent-of-par . Conditionally required for Fixed Income trades when LastPx <31> is expressed in Yield, Spread, Discount or any other type (see PriceType <423> ). Usage: Execution Report <8> and Allocation Report <AS> repeating executions block (from sellside).
